title: FTPS accounts
softwareMissing: FTPS service software is not installed
createHint: Create an FTP account first, then add SSH public keys for that user (top-right of list)
pubkeyHint: Use the list actions to register ssh-ed25519 / ssh-rsa keys for existing FTP users
quickSelectHint: Click a username to fill the new-key form
accountModalDesc: Pick domain and home from lists, or type freely. Save then Apply to write vsftpd
usernameHintCreate: Alnum, dot, underscore, hyphen; immutable after create
domainHint: Site or mail domain for grouping and path hints
domainPh: Create site/mail domain first, or type temporarily
addPubkeyDesc: Paste one full public key line; writing authorized_keys ≠ verified login
ftpUsernameHint: Must match a registered FTP account
deleteKeyDesc: Removes from management file; system authorized_keys may need reload.
listenPortHint: Default 21; open firewall if using another port
ipStackHint: Most vsftpd builds: listen and listen_ipv6 are mutually exclusive;
bannerHint: Welcome string clients see after connect
pasvEndHint: Must be ≥ start; firewall must allow the range
openPortsAlert: FTPS does not open the firewall for you. Allow TCP {{ports}} on the host firewall and cloud security group. Login OK but LIST timeout usually means the PASV range is blocked.
firewallPresetHint: On the firewall page, pick the FTPS+PASV preset and apply yourself (still your confirmatio
pasvPublicIpNeeded: On cloud/NAT, leaving PASV public IP empty may advertise a private address. Set your public IP under Network (e.g. 84.x.x.x).
pasvPublicIpHint: NAT/cloud: set public IP; local can leave empty
securityDesc: TLS, write access, chroot; Apply and restart to take effect
forceTlsLoginDesc: Reject plain FTP; clients need FTPS
writableChrootDesc: Keep chroot even when home is writable (common vsftpd need)
accountsListDesc: After create, Apply to sync vsftpd. If service missing, install above then
noFtpAccountsDesc: Create account (list top-right); set home and domain, then apply.
applyHint: Note: Apply writes management only; listening needs vsftpd active.
sshdMatchNote: ; system sshd Match must be configured to take effect.
emptyHomes: If the list is empty, create a project or site first for home options.
installFtpsBanner: Use the banner above to install FTPS, then start the service.
afterInstall: After install you can log in with FTPS accounts. Admin rights needed to install.
saveApplyHint: Save updates panel only; Apply and restart writes vsftpd.conf and reloads.
pasvIpShort: PASV public IP empty — set on Network.
